newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Ag Min ups 96/97 soy crop to 26.16 mln tns.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Ag Min ups 96/97 soy crop to 26.16 mln tns.

text.p: Brazil's 1996/97 soybean crop should reach 26.16 million tonnes, up 12.8 percent from 23.19 million tonnes in 1995/96, according to a press release from the Agriculture Ministry's National Supply Company (Conab).
The estimate is Conab's fifth and compares with a May forecast of 25.99 million tonnes. Previously however it had plotted the soybean harvest at 26.41 million tonnes.
Independent analysts Safras e Mercado at the end of May plotted the crop at 26.02 million tonnes.

Conab now sees Brazil's total grains and oilseeds crop at 79.21 million tonnes, slightly below its previous forecast of 79.41 million but still 7.7 percent up on the 73.52 million tonnes produced in 1995/96.
Corn output is now estimated at 36.14 million tonnes against 36.55 million previously.
